description: This PHP file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeLeaveEntitlementUsageLeaveReportDataAPI endpoint within the OrangeHRM HRMS application. It tests various functionalities such as retrieving all leave entitlement usage data and checks for unimplemented methods like delete and create. The class is part of the leave API tests, specifically targeting the report data API for employee leave entitlements and usage.
